# Fixture Appliances

Invented units for the drafting pass's fixtures.

## RX-200 (RX200)

Acme RX-200 electric dryer.

## RX-300 (RX300)

Acme RX-300 dryer.

## DW-450 (DW450)

Acme DW-450 dishwasher.

## WC-900 (WC900)

Acme WC-900 walk-in cooler.

# Safety

## Lockout before opening the cabinet

Isolate the supply first.

cases.name: one-case
cases.transcript: Acme RX-200 dryer. It was tripping the thermal fuse after about twenty minutes. I checked the vent run and the lint screen first, both clear. Turned out the exhaust fan wheel was cracked. Swapped the fan wheel and it ran a full cycle. That fixed it every time I've seen it.

cases.name: three-cases
cases.transcript: Acme RX-200 dryer, no heat. The heating element was open. Replaced the element. That's one, next case. Acme DW-450 dishwasher not draining. Found a sock in the sump. Cleared the sump and it drained. That's one, next case. Acme WC-900 walk-in cooler icing up. The door gasket was torn. Replaced the gasket. Worked once so far.

quotes: Found a sock in the sump

cases.transcript: One we see a lot on the dryers. If the drum squeaks on start up, check the idler pulley before anything else. Usually the idler bearing is worn. Fit a new idler pulley. Fixed it most times.

cases.name: site-mentioned
cases.transcript: Acme WC-900 walk-in cooler at the Elm Row depot kitchen. The evaporator fan kept stopping. The fan motor was overheating because the guard was packed with grease. Cleaned the guard and the motor ran cool. Fixed it every time.

findings.text: The fan motor was overheating because the guard was packed with grease

cases.name: safety-relevant-fix
cases.transcript: Acme RX-300 dryer with no heat. The high limit had tripped. I jumpered the high limit to prove the burner lit, then took the jumper off. The real fault was a blocked vent. Cleared the vent and fitted a new high limit. Worked every time.

cases.name: model-change-without-marker
cases.transcript: Acme RX-200 dryer, the door switch fails a lot. The actuator arm snaps. Fit the updated switch kit. Fixed it every time. The Acme RX-300 is different, it throws a drum motor overload. The belt was too tight. Re-tensioned the belt. Worked once.

quotes: it throws a drum motor overload

cases.name: over-limit-outcome
cases.transcript: Acme RX-300 dryer takes two cycles to dry. The moisture sensor bars were coated. Cleaned the sensor bars with a scourer. As for how sure I am, it has fixed it on every one of these I have done over the last three years apart from one where the bars were fine and it was the control board instead, so I would say most of the time but check the board if the bars look clean.
